player_prompt.intro:
Uyini Player {player_id} eNim.
Vuyelo byaku ku va swivuri leswo.
Hikuva sweswi, khetha pile yin'wana n'wana naswona u tshike swivuri leswo.
Lamula kwa muano '[pile quantity]', loko pile i ndlela ya pile naswona quantity i nguvu ya swivuri leswo.
Tanihi kufana, '[0 3]' ku tshika swivuri leswo tatu e pile 0.

invalid_move.wrong_format: A ku na mfungho lowu nga kona. Tirhisa '[pile quantity]'.
invalid_move.correct_format_wrong_fields: Player {player_id}, Swivuri leswo. Kolonne {col} i tinga ngopfu.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Pile index {pile_index} is out of range.
invalid_move.non_positive: U fanele ku susa nchumu wun'we.
invalid_move.exceeds_pile: A ku na ku tshika {quantity} eka pile {pile_index} (niku ve na {pile_count} pele).

observation.removed_from_piles: Player {player_id} played [{pile_index} {quantity}], removing {quantity} object(s) from pile {pile_index}.

outcome.win: Mutlangi {player_id} u teke nchumu wo hetelela (s)!
